It has been applicable since 20 April 2016. The amount of waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE) generated every year in the EU is increasing rapidly. It is now one of the fastest-growing waste streams. Electrical and electronic equipment (EEE) can also contain hazardous substances. Since 2003, EU laws have sought to address these challenges by restricting the use of hazardous substances in EEE through the RoHS Directive .
